# Data Management and Sharing Plan

## 1. Maximum Appropriate Sharing

Will there be maximum appropriate sharing of scientific data underlying
peer-reviewed publications and other findings resulting from the supported
work?

**Response:** [YES / NO]

## 2. Sharing Timeline

Will scientific data underlying peer-reviewed publications be shared by the
time of publication and data underlying other findings by the end of the period
of performance, including no-cost extensions?

**Response:** [YES / NO]

## 3. Availability Period

Will shared scientific data remain available for at least as long as required
by applicable repository or journal policies?

**Response:** [YES / NO]

## 4. Limitations on Sharing

_If any response to Elements 1–3 is NO, or sharing will otherwise be limited,
describe the specific ethical, legal, or technical factors. Maximum 300 words.
Enter Not Applicable when no limitation is anticipated._

## 5. Human Participant Privacy

If scientific data derived from human research participants will be shared,
will participant privacy, rights, and confidentiality be protected, including
through access controls when appropriate?

**Response:** [YES / NO / Not Applicable]

## 6. Expected Data and Repositories

_List the key scientific data types and an established repository or example
repository for each. Maximum 100 words total._

| Expected scientific data type | Species and modality | Repository |
|---|---|---|
| [Data type] | [Species and modality] | [Repository] |

## 7. Genomic Data Sharing Policy

### 7a. Repository and Accelerated Timeline

For studies subject to the NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy, will all large-scale
human genomic and associated data be shared through an NIH-designated
repository on the expected accelerated timeline?

**Response:** [YES / NO / Not Applicable]

### 7b. Institutional Certification

For large-scale human genomic data, will the expectations for Institutional
Certification under the Genomic Data Sharing Policy be met?

**Response:** [YES / NO / Not Applicable]

_Address any NO response to Element 7 in Element 4._
